report.md.content_text:
# RIPII world-model benchmark

Decision: **no_advance**. Development evidence only.

Checkpoint selection used validation only. Values are position RMSE mean ± sample standard deviation across initialization seeds.

| Model | In distribution | More objects | Held-out properties | Faster motion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| graph_continuous | 0.0904 ± 0.0075 | 0.1164 ± 0.0057 | 0.1203 ± 0.0058 | 0.1755 ± 0.0254 |
| global_pool_continuous | 0.0920 ± 0.0070 | 0.1235 ± 0.0056 | 0.1325 ± 0.0054 | 0.2167 ± 0.0262 |
| multiscale_continuous | 0.0983 ± 0.0097 | 0.1216 ± 0.0033 | 0.1301 ± 0.0074 | 0.2130 ± 0.0275 |

## Analytic baselines

| Baseline | In distribution | More objects | Held-out properties | Faster motion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| persistence | 0.3366 | 0.3051 | 0.3467 | 0.4884 |
| constant_velocity | 0.2276 | 0.2415 | 0.2128 | 0.5536 |
| force_kinematic | 0.2276 | 0.2419 | 0.2116 | 0.5518 |
